bug_semantics: An authenticated Contributor who can create or edit a mep_events post can store quote-bearing payloads in event address fields (venue, street, city, state, postcode, and country) and related configurable registration labels. The save path used strip_tags() historically and later sanitize_text_field(), neither of which performs output-context encoding. Those stored values were subsequently returned from post/term metadata and inserted without escaping into single-quoted HTML value attributes and Google Maps iframe URLs (and labels into attribute contexts), so a quote could terminate the attribute and add an event handler that executes when a privileged user or visitor renders the affected event/admin page.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable mechanism predates the assigned GitHub clone. Its root commit 644782aed278644a141d8d29ea5edfb4311ffad9 is a version-3.2.3/3.2.4 development import that already contains the raw metadata-return helper, so it is not the smallest real BIC. Decomposing that import through the plugin's first-party WordPress SVN history identifies SVN r1815482, represented by the full-history SVN-to-Git mirror commit 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020, as the initial version-1.0 release that first added inc/mep_event_meta.php. That commit simultaneously stored the six address parameters using strip_tags() and echoed the stored values directly into quoted attributes; its immediate parent contains no mage-eventpress source.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020 records both author and committer as magepeopleteam <magepeopleteam@b8457f37-d9ea-0310-8a92-e5e31aec5664>, with the exact message 'Initial release of mage woo event booking manager' and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer.
evidence: Advisory: GHSA-j4j4-476p-c2qf/CVE-2025-5568 states stored XSS through multiple parameters in every release through 4.4.2 and links https://github.com/magepeopleteam/mage-eventpress/commit/c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144 and WordPress changeset 3307484. Vulnerable path at the BIC: https://plugins.svn.wordpress.org/!svn/rvr/1815482/mage-eventpress/trunk/inc/mep_event_meta.php and the identical mirror tree at https://src.sharkdat.com/WordPress-C/mage-eventpress/raw/commit/88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020/inc/mep_event_meta.php show mep_location_venue, mep_street, mep_city, mep_state, mep_postcode, and mep_country read from get_post_custom(), emitted directly in single-quoted value attributes, accepted from POST through strip_tags(), and persisted with update_post_meta(). The BIC plugin header at https://src.sharkdat.com/WordPress-C/mage-eventpress/raw/commit/88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020/woocommerce-event-press.php is Version 1.0. Smallest-origin/parent proof: first-party PROPFIND for SVN baseline r1815482 returns date 2018-02-05T07:05:26.156370Z, author magepeopleteam, and log 'Initial release of mage woo event booking manager'; r1815481 returns 404 for trunk/inc/mep_event_meta.php. The corresponding mirror commit API at https://src.sharkdat.com/api/v1/repos/WordPress-C/mage-eventpress/git/commits/88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020 gives parent 213cf47c76e05bb53d991129340561634a4fe40b and reports inc/mep_event_meta.php as added; requesting that path at the parent returns 404. Assigned-clone decomposition: git log --follow --reverse -S'function mep_get_event_locaion_item' -- inc/mep_functions.php leads only to root import 644782aed278644a141d8d29ea5edfb4311ffad9, whose plugin header is 3.2.3 and whose commit object has no parent; the older first-party SVN source proves it is an aggregate import, not the BIC. Fix lifecycle: git show c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144 adds esc_html() around the raw post/term location returns and esc_attr() around registration-label metadata. Merge 7d59237ae8ae6e0f264791adb92e7352bcc81de8 lands c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144 as its second parent; follow-on 071468739aa98faa528c387d300d67aa68eb2966 escapes remaining calendar/list location reads and changes the plugin header from 4.4.2 in parent 7d59237ae8ae6e0f264791adb92e7352bcc81de8 to patched 4.4.3. The repository has no Git tags, so the checked plugin headers plus the advisory range establish the version boundary.
reasoning: The vulnerability is an output-context failure, not merely a missing tag stripper: quote characters survive strip_tags()/sanitize_text_field(), remain stored in event metadata, and become executable markup when interpolated unescaped into HTML attributes. The current GitHub history initially points to 644782aed278644a141d8d29ea5edfb4311ffad9, but that root already labels the plugin 3.2.3 while first-party WordPress SVN preserves the vulnerable version-1.0 implementation. Therefore the root import was decomposed rather than mislabeled as the BIC. SVN r1815482/the corresponding full-history mirror SHA 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020 is the smallest change: it adds the vulnerable source, and both the first-party r1815481 tree and mirror parent 213cf47c76e05bb53d991129340561634a4fe40b lack that path. Version 1.0 necessarily precedes the advisory's affected-through-4.4.2 boundary; direct remediation c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144 is merged and completed at the 4.4.3 release commit 071468739aa98faa528c387d300d67aa68eb2966. Finally, only the reconstructed BIC commit object was used for attribution: it has a human/team identity and plain initial-release message with no AI marker. Later commits, branches, PR metadata, and the fix authorship were not used to infer the BIC's authorship, yielding NOT_AI.
